label: PF Backlog 46
title: Add per-agent control to the backend (start/stop/pause/resume/cancel + status)
body: Backend-first (owner): the pipeline currently controls at PROJECT/pipeline level only (control.json stop|pause|resume; approvals; interactive answers; rerun via --only-stage/--from-stage/--agent). There is NO per-agent control channel. Add real per-agent control: start (run a specific agent/stage scope), stop (finish current agent then halt), pause (before next agent), resume, cancel/abort a specific agent, plus per-agent status (extend agents-live.json / state_machine) with the same cross-process discipline (control.json-style, lock-safe, audit-logged). Dashboard consumes it via a thin API. Paired dashboard item: BI-0026.

decisions.note: [P3] Per-agent control channel + status (dashboard agent controls depend on it).

dashboard_impact.reason: agent control UI surface exists (per-agent start/stop/pause/resume/cancel)
